description: Even (cosh/Vol) channel of the winding lattice (#4401/#4405): derived exactly, Re 𝔙₄₁(u_{m,ℓ}) = Vol₄₁ − (3/8)(ln q₀)²·(2m+ℓ)ℓ — the CROSS form, the second integer form alongside the sign channel's norm form (2m+ℓ)²−3ℓ². Scope-(a): these candidates alone as-is are excluded; magnitude OPEN; nothing adopted, nothing wired, no tuning (all candidates fixed before evaluation).
